theorems.statement: (∀ (P n : ℕ) (U : Set (Euclid P)) (T : GeometricCurrentOn U n) (R : IMRep U n), IsOpen U → R.Represents T → ∀ W : Set (Euclid P), IsOpen W → T.massOn W = R.measure W) → (∀ (P n : ℕ) (U : Set (Euclid P)) (S : GeometricCurrentOn U n) (ω : TestFormOn U n), Disjoint (tsupport (ω : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) n)) S.support → S ω = 0) → (∀ (P m : ℕ), m + 1 < P → ∃ c : ℝ, 1 ≤ c ∧ ∀ Z : GeometricCurrentOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) (m + 1), IsIntegerMultiplicity Z → IsCompact Z.support → Z.boundary = 0 → Z.mass < ∞ → ∃ Y : GeometricCurrentOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) (m + 2), IsIntegerMultiplicity Y ∧ Y.boundary = Z ∧ Y.mass ≤ ENNReal.ofReal (c * (2 * c * Z.mass.toReal) ^ ((1 : ℝ) / (m + 1)) * Z.mass.toReal) ∧ Y.support ⊆ thickening (3 * Real.sqrt P * (2 * c * Z.mass.toReal) ^ ((1 : ℝ) / (m + 1))) Z.support) → ∀ (P d : ℕ), d + 1 < P → (∃ η₀ : ℝ, 0 < η₀ ∧ ∀ (C : GeometricCurrentOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) (d + 1)) (μ : Measure (Euclid P)) (ξ : Euclid P → MultiVector P (d + 1)), C.boundary = 0 → (∀ K : Set (Euclid P), IsCompact K → μ K < ∞) → (∀ W : Set (Euclid P), IsOpen W → C.massOn W = μ W) → AEStronglyMeasurable ξ μ → (∀ᵐ x ∂μ, ∀ α : Covector (Euclid P) (d + 1), |ξ x α| ≤ covectorEuclideanNorm α) → (∀ ω : TestFormOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) (d + 1), C ω = ∫ x, ξ x ((ω : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) (d + 1)) x) ∂μ) → (∀ (μ μ' : Measure (Euclid P)) (ξ : Euclid P → MultiVector P (d + 1)) (ξ' : Euclid P → MultiVector P d), (∀ K : Set (Euclid P), IsCompact K → μ K < ∞) → (∀ K : Set (Euclid P), IsCompact K → μ' K < ∞) → AEStronglyMeasurable ξ μ → AEStronglyMeasurable ξ' μ' → (∀ᵐ x ∂μ, ∀ α : Covector (Euclid P) (d + 1), |ξ x α| ≤ covectorEuclideanNorm α) → (∀ᵐ x ∂μ', ∀ α : Covector (Euclid P) d, |ξ' x α| ≤ covectorEuclideanNorm α) → (∀ ω : TestFormOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) (d + 1), C ω = ∫ x, ξ x ((ω : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) (d + 1)) x) ∂μ) → (∀ η : TestFormOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) d, (C).boundary η = ∫ x, ξ' x ((η : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) d) x) ∂μ') → ∀ (f : Euclid P → ℝ) (L : NNReal), LipschitzWith L f → ∀ᵐ t ∂(volume : Measure ℝ), ∀ (A : GeometricCurrentOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) (d + 1)) (B : GeometricCurrentOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) d), (∀ ω : TestFormOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) (d + 1), A ω = ∫ x in {x | f x < t}, ξ x ((ω : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) (d + 1)) x) ∂μ) → (∀ η : TestFormOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) d, B η = ∫ x in {x | f x < t}, ξ' x ((η : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) d) x) ∂μ') → IsIntegerMultiplicity (A.boundary - B)) → ∀ᵐ x ∂μ, ENNReal.ofReal η₀ ≤ liminf (fun r : ℝ => μ (ball x r) / (unitBallVolume (d + 1) * ENNReal.ofReal (r ^ (d + 1)))) (𝓝[>] 0))
